answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 160285 Country: india Title: Can I recite surah in 4 rakah sunnah as, in 1st rakah Surah Kausar, in 2nd rakah Surah Kafirun, in 3rd rakah Surah Falaq and in 4th rakah Surah Naas. Question: Can I recite surah in 4 rakah sunnah as, in 1st rakah Surah Kausar, in 2nd rakah Surah Kafirun, in 3rd rakah Surah Falaq and in 4th rakah Surah Naas. Answer ID: 160285 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 850/690/SN=8/1439) It is mandatory to recite any other Surah after reciting Surah Fatiha in every rakah of four rakah sunnah salah. Reciting only Surah Fatiha in the last two rakah of four rakah of fardh salah is specific with fardh salah only. However, it should be noted that any other Surah should be recited in such a way that the second rakah is not longer than the first one i.e. one should not read Surah Kauthar in the first rakah and Surah Kafirun in the second rakah, it is makrooh to do so. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
